findings: Style: the opening says "These errors all mean the automation is missing something", but the duplicate-trigger error in step 5 is about having one too many, not something missing.

Style: step 1 leaves out the page's list of what can be missing (an active trigger, message text of 1 to 640 characters, valid button and webhook URLs, a message on every gate), which would help a customer find the flagged field.
